 India Today Video Desk UPDATED: Nov 12, 2026 18:08 IST 
 +Follow us on A Madhya Pradesh forest guard's video about the 2% DA hike around Diwali has raised questions about the actual benefit employees receive. DA, or Dearness Allowance, is paid over and above basic pay to account for inflation. The revision takes the rate from 58% to 60%, with the additional amount and arrears scheduled for payment as per the government's announced timeline.
